attrs.rationale: Warm pools avoid cold-start latency while preserving sterile, deterministic execution environments.
ForgeHarbor is stateful, unlike ForgeAtlas, and must manage live containers, background reconciliation, heartbeats, and graceful shutdown.
Defines ForgeHarbor as a long-running daemon with Pool Manager, Lifecycle Engine, Heartbeat Monitor, and Provider Interface.
Builds pure lifecycle logic first, then provider, pool, daemon, and Docker packaging.
Prioritizes transition guard, lifecycle functions, provider contract, PoolManager, and assignment lock as P0 dependencies.

edges.evidence: start() performs initial self.pool.reconcile().
start() calls self.heartbeat_monitor.start().
start() creates a Thread with target self._reconcile_loop.
start() reads self.pool.get_pool_status() for startup summary.
shutdown() releases each assigned environment via self.pool.release_environment.
shutdown() calls provider.terminate(env_id); concrete provider may be DockerProvider or MockProvider.
request_environment() delegates to self.pool.request_environment(session_id).
release_environment() delegates to self.pool.release_environment(environment_id).
get_pool_status() calls self.pool.get_pool_status().
health() computes status from self.pool.get_pool_status().
_reconcile_loop() repeatedly calls self.pool.reconcile().
__init__ reads FORGE_HARBOR_* environment variables into self.config.
ForgeHarborDaemon constructs PoolManager with provider and pool policy values.
ForgeHarborDaemon constructs HeartbeatMonitor with pool and provider.
ForgeHarborDaemon selects DockerProvider when use_mock_provider is false.
ForgeHarborDaemon selects MockProvider when use_mock_provider is true.
reconcile() calls _provision_new_environment() while below ready targets.
WARMING timeout path calls on_provision_failure(env).
DRAINING completion checks get_blocking_intents(env.environment_id).
If no blocking intents remain, reconcile() calls on_drain_complete(env).
_provision_new_environment() constructs EnvironmentSpec from environment variables.
_provision_new_environment() creates ExecutionEnvironment(environment_id=env_id, status=COLD).
_provision_new_environment() calls self.provider.provision(env_id, spec).
After physical provisioning, _provision_new_environment() calls provision(env).
Phase 3 simplification immediately completes warming with on_warm_complete(env).
Logical lifecycle is paired with provider provisioning and termination for physical containers.
request_environment() assigns READY env via assign(env, session_id).
request_environment() calls provider.get_connection_info(env.environment_id).
Returns dicts shaped as status ok/error with payload or error.
release_environment() calls begin_drain(env).
get_pool_status() returns environment_pool_utilization, average_provision_time_ms, and environment_recycle_rate aliases for CONCORD.
provision() checks can_transition before WARMING.
on_warm_complete() checks can_transition before READY.
on_provision_failure() checks can_transition before TERMINATED.
assign() checks can_transition before ASSIGNED.
begin_drain() checks can_transition before DRAINING.
ASSIGNED drain path calls get_blocking_intents(env.environment_id).
on_drain_complete() checks can_transition before TERMINATED.
recycle() checks can_transition before producing a COLD environment.
recycle() returns a new ExecutionEnvironment with a new UUID.
The transition table is keyed by EnvironmentStatus values.
ExecutionEnvironment.status is an EnvironmentStatus.
check_once() calls provider.check_health(env.environment_id).
Failed health path calls mark_environment_unhealthy(env).
Failed assigned path requests session_intents with get_blocking_intents(env.environment_id).
Failed health path calls handle_unhealthy_environment(env, session_intents, compensate_fn).
